text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I ran into Satono Crown walking with a cheerful spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, the open campus event is coming up soon, right?
My class is planning to set up a food stall.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And today, we're having a class meeting to decide what kind of shop to run!
I'm planning to propose an egg tart stand.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I get to hear everyone's carefully thought-out ideas while getting feedback on my own!
It's such a constructive occasion! How could I not be thrilled?♪
choice_data_list: I see, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything I can so I have good news to report!
Well, look forward to it, okay?
choice_data_list: (I should think about what I can do to help, too.)
(Maybe I should think of what I can do to help too.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well then... could you help promote our egg tarts
both on and off campus? Just whatever you're able to do.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll put up some posts on Umastagram for now~

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Could you work on the flyer design?
We'd love an eye-catching, pop-style look—your specialty!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
No prob at all, but...
if anything, I'm way better at signboards, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Flyers take time to print, so I want them done early.
I'll definitely need your help on the signboard later! Start brainstorming ideas, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...As for the budget, other classes are setting up stalls too...
If we combine shipping through bulk orders, we can keep costs down...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is finding a supplier... but since I don't have
any food industry contacts... I'll have to start from scratch—
choice_data_list: I've already looked into a few suppliers for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer...?! Zan hai?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that after hearing about the egg tart stall,
I took the initiative to pick out several food suppliers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Great! Thank you so much, that saves me a ton of work...!
Thanks to you, we saved time. I'll get straight to negotiating—
choice_data_list: We should probably adjust your training schedule, too.
We should probably adjust your training schedule, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah... right! Things will be a bit irregular for a while...
It'd be super helpful if you could build in about an hour of extra leeway compared to usual!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
The menu's all finished~! Just the signboard left, huh~.
I'd really love to wrap this up before it gets dark~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! If we all pull together, we can definitely do it.
Come on, let's give it one final push for tomorrow!
choice_data_list: How about a sweet treat before that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! A sweet treat... you brought snacks?!
Whoa, they look delicious! Did you go out of your way to get these for us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod. Hearing that Satono Crown and her classmates would be prepping until late,
I brought enough refreshments for the whole class.
choice_data_list: It's the least I can do.
It's the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Not at all... this is the absolute best support ever!
Thanks to you, we're totally ready for the home stretch!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's Crownie's Trainer for ya.
Showing up right when everyone's craving something sweet!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, totally~ Always like this, like they can read her mind...
Shows just how well they understand Crownie~

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! But you know—we're just getting started!
We're going to understand each other even more than this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of taking them to Hong Kong during the upcoming long break.
Surrounding ourselves with the finest environment will bring us even closer, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Training efficiency will shoot up,
and they can study business under my father, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If all goes well, entering overseas races there
might yield brand-new breakthroughs for us...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
A long trip abroad with your Trainer, huh...
That's pretty bold, but nice that they agreed to it so easily.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
How careless of me...
I just took it for granted that they'd be coming along.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, knowing your Trainer, it'll probably be fine.
Though if you're heading overseas, you really oughta tell 'em, right~?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, quite. My Trainer has plans of their own, after all.
I must ask as soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Still, right now we have to focus on prepping for the event.
Come on, everyone, let's power through this last spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, thanks to their hard work, the egg tart stall
became an enormous hit, drawing massive, winding queues.
